newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Possible carryover short covering but drop in cash beef seen weighing on market.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Index lower and corn called higher should offset firmer technicals.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Steady to higher cash calls on reduced runs may offset pressure from lower pork.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Large drop in cash bellies may offset other factors.
